title: Android Aeronautics
description: A simple modpack based around Create Aeronautics, lightweight, optimized, and compatible with Android emulators.
body:
**👽 Android Aeronautics** is a lightweight modpack built around *[Create Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics)*, focused on performance, smooth gameplay, and accessibility.

<iframe width="320" height="180" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/SO8tpWfZjGk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Designed especially for **Android players using emulators**, this modpack is carefully optimized to deliver a stable experience even on limited hardware — without sacrificing core gameplay features.

### ⚙️ Features
- 🚀 Create-based automation and aeronautics gameplay  
- 📦 Essential QoL mods (inventory, map, storage, UI improvements)  
- ⚡ Performance-focused setup with minimal overhead  
- 🔧 Fully tuned for **low-end devices and Android emulators**  

### 💡 Who is it for?
- 📱 Android emulator players looking for a smooth experience  
- 💻 PC players with **low-spec machines**  
- 🛠️ Fans of Create who want a **clean and optimized modpack**  

---

Simple, efficient, and ready to fly.
